rows.grounds: locative expression indicating the specific moment
first member of compound with siddhiḥ
locative adverb referring to this situation

items.question: What certainty of intended-act accomplishment obtains at that moment without further deliberation?
premises: Accomplishment of the intended act arises at that moment.
Further deliberation is not to be undertaken in this situation.
items.inference: Therefore, at that moment the intended act succeeds without need for additional deliberation.
uncertainties: The exact scope of kārya depends on the preceding ritual context.
items.plain_english: At that time, the intended act will be accomplished; in this case, no further deliberation should be made.
